technical_and_design_decisions: For U1 (Queue/Topic cleanup), use Spring AMQP's RabbitAdmin.getQueueProperties() to check consumer count and decide on cleanup; optionally invoke RabbitMQ REST API via RabbitManagementTemplate if available; make the cleanup optional via '--clean' flag in stream destroy command.
For U2 (Exception notification), tap into Spring Integration error channels; use a global error channel listener that publishes exceptions to a dedicated error stream/module.

For U3 (Security configuration), leverage Spring Security and Spring Boot's auto-configuration; use OAuth2 or basic auth for REST endpoints; configure security credentials via application properties and environment variables; update DSL shell to support secured endpoints; integrate with Admin UI using session-based or token-based authentication.
For U4 (Documentation of placeholder keys), update the official documentation to list all available placeholder keys (e.g., ${xd.stream.name}, ${xd.job.name}, ${xd.container.id}) with examples.

For U5 (MVC-aware HTTP module), create a new HTTP source module based on embedded Tomcat with Spring MVC support; implement full header mapping and content-type negotiation; reuse existing Spring XD module structure.

For U6 (Polling and events), implement client-side polling with configurable interval; on server-side, use Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher to propagate status changes; consider using WebSocket or Server-Sent Events for push notifications to UI.

For U7 (SFTP source), use Spring Integration SFTP adapter; design configuration properties for host, port, credentials, remote directory; implement a test infrastructure using embedded SFTP server (e.g., Apache MINA SSHD).
For U8 (ElasticSearch sink), use Elasticsearch Spring Data or native REST client; handle indexing of data fields; provide configuration for cluster nodes, authentication, index name.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD (or Spring Cloud Data Flow) codebase is used as the foundation; all development is done in Java 17+.
The developer is familiar with Spring Framework, Spring Integration, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, and Spring Security.
All user stories are implemented within the same software increment; no dependencies between stories block parallel work.
Required dependencies (e.g., RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, SFTP server) are available in the test environment.
The effort estimates assume a single developer working full-time without interruptions.
Testing includes unit tests, integration tests, and manual verification for each story.
Documentation updates are limited to the scope of the user stories (no comprehensive rework).

activities.activity_name: Implement U1: Queue/Topic cleanup on stream destroy
activities.activity_description: Design and implement optional cleanup of queues/topics when destroying a stream using the '--clean' flag. Use RabbitAdmin to check consumers and conditionally delete. Handle fanout exchanges and data retention scenarios.

activities.activity_name: Implement U2: Exception notification via error channel
activities.activity_description: Add error channel support to stream modules so that exceptions are published to a configurable channel; enable user to tap into the error channel for processing failures.

activities.activity_name: Implement U3: Security configurations for REST endpoints
activities.activity_description: Integrate Spring Security to secure all REST API endpoints. Design configuration approach for credentials, handle DSL shell and Admin UI integration. Implement OOTB security using Spring Boot auto-configuration.

activities.activity_name: Implement U4: Document available placeholder keys
activities.activity_description: Research and document all placeholder keys (e.g., ${xd.stream.name}) available to users in stream and job definitions. Update the official documentation accordingly.

activities.activity_name: Implement U5: OOTB MVC-aware HTTP module with embedded Tomcat
activities.activity_description: Build a new HTTP source module that embeds Tomcat and supports Spring MVC features (content-type, header mapping). Ensure compatibility with existing HTTP source usage.

activities.activity_name: Implement U6: Polling strategy and event propagation for status changes
activities.activity_description: Develop client-side polling for stream/job status changes. On server-side, implement event propagation (e.g., ApplicationEvent) between containers and admin server. Optionally add WebSocket/SSE support for UI clients.
Create an SFTP source module using Spring Integration SFTP adapter. Include configuration for connection parameters and file polling. Set up test infrastructure with embedded SFTP server.
Develop an ElasticSearch sink module that indexes data in real-time. Use Spring Data Elasticsearch or native client. Provide configuration for cluster nodes and index settings.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all implemented features. Ensure compatibility, fix defects, and verify that combined changes work together.
Write or update documentation for all new features. Prepare release notes, update API docs, and ensure configuration reference is complete.
